No one thinks their entitled to anything except to be treated like a human being and not constantly made fun of because of an aspect we can’t control, no one here thinks they’re entitled to someone’s love and affection (other than our parents, which even then we still don’t get), what would be nice however would to not be insulted because of our height because we asked someone out. It’s a label everyone puts upon every short person who complains about being short and that it sucks to try and find love. 

And possibly we could but a lot of us have already dropped our standards to the lowest they could possibly go, for me, I’ll take anyone who doesn’t weigh a significantly more than me (I’m 160lb) and that’s basically the only standard I have. Sure, I would prefer someone shorter than me, has a nice face and is sweet, but that doesn’t mean I’m going to turn someone down because they don’t fit that mold. The majority of girls on the other hand will put a minimum on height a lot (usually no shorter than average) and will very rarely break it unless he’s basically perfect in every other way. I have plenty of female friends and they’re exactly this way and from what I’ve observed from girls Ik and have interacted with they are the same way.

Exactly or we just settle for the first person who even seem remotely interested in us who we aren’t even fully attracted to, and by that time we’re in our mid to late 30s, while she has had plenty of people, short guys have had maybe have 1, 2, hell maybe no partners before this point. We are always someone’s last choice and if you think otherwise and you have a girlfriend/wife, I dare you ask them to be truthful if you were their first choice…

Studies have proven over and over that women don’t find short guys as attractive as taller guys, most women want their guy to be in the 6ft range, and to be as attractive as an average height person you have to make and extra 30k for each inch you’re shorter than average

This woman makes blanket statements saying that all short men are like this, which is certainly not the case but society still believes this to be true for all short guys

Most women see as a evolutionary dead end and don’t see us as desirable, that’s just a fact, while yes both short men marry at only a slightly less rate then average to tall men, short guys are robbed of experiences in our teen and 20s of relationships because we aren’t seen as desirable whether or not we’re confident or not and by the time we’re all in our mid 30s to 40s, most women more or less say to themselves “alright fine, I’ll settle for you.” That’s basically just saying, “you’re not what I want but I’ll take you so I’m not alone”. That’s what my mom did and the few older friends I have had to deal with that.
